title: Giovanna Elizabeth Pillaca Morote
gallery_text: The Digital Altarpiece is a virtual temple to preserve and communicate traditional cultural and funeral rituals from places like Peru. This project was developed in pandemic using GANS, opening the question how HI and AI could collaborate in a creative process.

answers.interest: I would like to understand more the field of simulations, and agents. And see If I could integrate more technically new tools in my practice. For example If I could simulate organic forms, following a biogrowth pattern, and test if this simulations could be habitable, adding agents in the virtual space.
answers.suggestions: https://www.oxman.com/projects/eden This is a referential project that I am interest in learning more how this works and how it can be develop.
